personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Adapted for Android-first POS utility)
personality_one_liner: A fast, professional, and hyper-legible business utility designed for rapid shop counter operations with minimal friction.

spacing.rule: Prioritize touch-friendly margins for POS environment. Large tap targets minimal 48pt spacing for CTAs.

dont's: Do not use blur or glass UI; POS needs absolute visibility and fast rendering on low-end Androids.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide quick store stats and a grid of frequent actions (New Invoice, Add Stock, etc.) for fast access.
screens.layout: Top hero section with key stats (Today's Sales, Low Stock count) using brandPrimary and accent colors. Below, a 2-column or 3-column grid of large, touch-friendly action cards.

screens.name: Catalogue
screens.purpose: Quickly search, filter, and view the massive 11k product list.
screens.layout: Sticky top search bar with horizontal filter chips (Supplier, Category). Flat list of products with clear stock indicators (red if low stock).

screens.name: Invoices
screens.purpose: Create and manage GST invoices rapidly at the counter.
screens.layout: List of recent invoices with status tags. Floating Action Button (FAB) or prominent sticky button for 'New Invoice'. Builder uses step-by-step clear validation.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage app preferences, backup/restore data, and shop details.
screens.layout: Standard grouped list layout with clear dividers. Destructive actions (like data reset) must have confirmation dialogs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use system fonts strictly to support the offline-first requirement; do not import Google Fonts.
Implement the 4 main sections as bottom tabs: Dashboard, Catalogue, Invoices, Settings.
Design with large tap targets (minimum 48pt) suitable for rapid shop counter operations.
Ensure 'accent' (orange) is used sparingly, primarily for critical alerts, low stock badges, or primary emphasis against the navy/blue theme.
Disable unnecessary animations; the app must feel instant and responsive.
Implement 'solid surfaceSecondary' fallbacks instead of glassmorphism to ensure performance on lower-end Android devices typical in POS settings.
Always provide a confirmation dialog before executing destructive actions.
